gen-dafont-edo-sz-fs-chillax: Edo SZ stands its lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals, one stroke width throughout, while Chillax loops loosely beneath. Shrink the heading and that stature fades; enlarge Chillax and the loops sprawl.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-fs-synonym: Cultural and classic up top, Edo SZ stands tall in constant strokes, while Synonym lays a plain stripe of ink below. Edo SZ makes the entrance; Synonym does the steady work.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-fs-spline-sa: Spline Sans reads friendly and current, its curves left unclosed, while Eight Bit Dragon strides past in towering, widely spaced lowercase. Together on a page, the dragon leads and the sans trails.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-port-llig: Eight Bit Dragon strides, adventurous, its towering lowercase spread wide apart. Port Lligat Slab counters with porthole-wide lowercase and snug letterforms, made for quiet literary reading rather than announcing.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-bree-serif: Electroharmonix breaks words into single, open-handed letters with a sizable x-height that commands the screen. But Bree Serif, outsized in its lowercase, settles into text with a refined, literary ease.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-quando: Gaps that split each word into single letters give Electroharmonix its commanding look, round curves thrown open. Quando reads bookish and traditional, its sparse spacing and big middle zone letting every word breathe.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-plus-jakarta-: Electroharmonix breaks each word open into single, commanding letters. Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, its monoline strokes keeping curve endings well apart, so text moves along steadily.
gen-dafont-eraser-dm-sans: DM Sans reads friendly and approachable, with wide-set terminals on the s that keep each line easygoing. But Eraser, quietly commanding, keeps every bold stroke uniform, so its lowercase looks thin without ever thinning.
gen-dafont-eraser-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Understated yet commanding, Eraser keeps its bold letters uniform, while Be Vietnam Pro bends steel-rod strokes beneath it. Eraser holds the top note; the body line carries the words.
gen-dafont-eraser-gf-almendra-sc: Eraser draws every letter as if with a fixed-width nib. Almendra SC, authoritative and dignified, keeps its letter mouths open, so text unfolds with weight and a steady, unhurried ease.
